invariants.rationale: The method returns the output of postWrite(...), which is expected to be non-null according to typical usage.
The input records list is a required argument and typically should not be null.
The instantTime parameter is consistently used and passed to called methods; it should not be null.
The method's return type is List<WriteStatus>, so result should always be a List.
The Option<BulkInsertPartitioner> parameter should not be null (Option is used to represent absence/presence, not to encode null itself).
